defaults.a2-technology.2: One operating record, one brain, every surface — built to get cheaper as it grows.
defaults.a2-technology.3: SURFACESWeb, mobile, release email + SMS, and shareable briefs — every surface writes to the same record.
defaults.a2-technology.4: THE BRAINPer-function model routing behind an AI gateway, vector + graph memory per organization, the reconciliation engine, approval-gated actions with verified receipts.
defaults.a2-technology.5: OPERATING RECORDServerless Postgres, object storage, product analytics, and an event bus driving durable background jobs — the system of record the moat compounds in.
defaults.a2-technology.6: CONNECTORS & TRUST48 integrations with provider-scoped, revocable access; credentials in a secrets vault; per-organization isolation; full request tracing end to end.
defaults.a2-technology.8: Costs fall with the industry. Routing and caching mean every model-price drop lands straight in gross margin.
defaults.a2-technology.9: Event-driven by default. Ingestion, reconciliation, and verification run as durable jobs that scale horizontally.
defaults.a2-technology.10: Usage-based infrastructure. Serverless data and storage keep cost tracking revenue, not headcount.
defaults.a2-technology.11: Isolated per organization. The trust posture enterprise buyers ask for is the default, not a retrofit.

BUILT LEAN 2,598 API operations· 238 tables· 170 screens· 48 integrations Shipped on $275K — ~2× the capital efficiency

defaults.a10-trust-architecture.20: Customer data is isolated per organization and never trains a shared model. Encrypted in transit and at rest; connector credentials live in a dedicated secrets vault; every connection is provider-scoped and revocable by source. Actions are logged with receipts, and accounts can export or delete their data per policy.
